newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ayala Corp shares fall, join blue-chip drop.
newsitem.headline: Ayala Corp shares fall, join blue-chip drop.

text.p: Ayala Corp A fell by 75 centavos and the B shares by 1.50 pesos per share by late trade in Manila on Monday.
"There is no fundamental reason. In fact, the fundamentals have been quite good," said Felix Barrientos, trader at Baring Securities (Philippines) Inc.
Ayala A fell to 21.25 pesos per while the B shares fell to 29.50 pesos.
Ayala was falling along with other Manila blue chips such as Petron and Manila Electric.

"There's no good news in the market and there's the end of the month margin calls so there is no choice but to sell," said Bogart Cruz, trading manager at Asia Pacific Capital Equities & Securities Corp.
Barrientos added the shift of most investors to second-liners and tertiary stocks was also pulling down blue chips.
